testsuite.name: gg.rsmod.plugins.content.combat.formula.MagicCombatFormulaTests

testcase.name: Virtus' Ancient Magicks bonus scales per piece worn, not just full set
magic damage bonus (BonusSlot MAGIC_DAMAGE_BONUS, tenths of a percent) composes into max hit
Virtus gives no Ancient Magicks bonus on a standard-spellbook spell
an unbuffed caster deals exactly the spell's base max hit
void mage's 1_45x applies to the effective Attack level used for accuracy
protect from magic only zeroes accuracy against a non-player attacker
chaos gauntlets add a flat plus 3 to bolt spells before the magic damage multiplier
Augury's Magic Attack prayer multiplier composes into the attack roll
TargetModifiers' Salve amulet bonus does not change the magic max hit
gear, elite void and prayer magic damage add up before multiplying (OSRS Maximum magic hit)
the plain Salve amulet does not change magic accuracy (only Salve (i) and (ei) do)
full Virtus gives 15 percent extra magic damage on an Ancient Magicks spell, not the flat 6 percent spellbook
chaos gauntlets do not apply to a non-bolt spell
a larger magic damage bonus produces a strictly larger max hit once it crosses a whole point
